product.title: Mechanic's EDC — Wrench + Pliers Bundle
product.body_html:
The off-road mechanic's pocket.

The combo built for desert off-roading, trailer breakdowns, and every roadside repair scenario. Adjustable wrench profiles + precision pliers = handle 90% of emergency mechanical work without a full toolbox.

What's included

  • 1 × Roadside Fix — Multi-function tactical wrench (8mm-19mm hex, plier function, wire cutter)
  • 1 × Field Precision — Multi-function pliers (needle-nose, wire cutter, folding knife)
  • 2 × Belt-Loop Pouches
  • 1 × Survival72 Quick-Reference Card

Why this combo

Most off-road mechanical failures come down to fasteners that need turning (wheel nuts, hose clamps, undercarriage bolts) and wires/cables that need cutting or stripping (battery terminals, broken sensor leads). This kit covers both — packed flat, no rattle, no extra weight.

Specifications

Total Weight595 g
Combined Materials3CR13 hardened steel (wrench, black phosphate) + Stainless steel (pliers, natural silver finish)
Total Folding Knife Blades2 (7.5 cm in wrench + 7.2 cm in pliers)
PackagingStandard cardboard box

Save $29 vs buying separately

Bundle price: $82 (vs $94 if bought as individual items). Free shipping on orders over $35.

Shipping & Returns

Cash on Delivery available across UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, and Oman. 30-day return window from delivery date.
